definitions.explanation: Something that is expected or goes without saying. A matter of course.

examples.japanese: それは{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}です。
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}だと{思|おも}っていた。
{親|おや}に{感謝|かんしゃ}するのは{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}のことだ。
examples.english: It's only natural to be grateful to your parents.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}の{生活|せいかつ}がしたい。
examples.english: I want to live an ordinary life.

examples.japanese: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}のことを{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}にやる。
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}の{毎日|まいにち}が{一番|いちばん}{幸|しあわ}せだと{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: I realized that ordinary daily life is the happiest.

notes:
{当|あ}たり{前|まえ} indicates something is natural or expected.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}の/な + noun
- Noun: {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}だ (is natural/obvious)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}のことだ (it's only natural)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}に (naturally, as a matter of course)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}と{思|おも}う (take for granted)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {当然|とうぜん}: natural, obvious (formal)
- {当|あ}たり{前|まえ}: natural, obvious (casual)
- もちろん: of course (affirmation)
